verdict.rationale: Vast.ai explicitly documents templates as the mechanism for launching preconfigured environments ('A template is how Vast helps you launch an instance, setting up your rented machine with whatever software and formatting you need'), with one-click launch of prebuilt templates and named examples including PyTorch, vLLM, and ComfyUI ('Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click'; 'PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, agents, and more. Real deployments you can copy'). Docs also cover building custom templates for packaging environments. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of specific template quality or CUDA-specific template details beyond marketing copy.
